statements.status_notes: CVE-2025-9308: in Yarn 1.x up to 1.22.22, RequestManager.setOptions() in src/util/request-manager.js splits the contents of the configured cafile with the regular expression /(-----BEGIN .*\r?\n[^-]+\r?\n--.*)/, which takes super-linear time on a crafted certificate bundle (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2025-9308). Yarn 1.x is no longer maintained and has no fixed release; the fix proposed upstream in https://github.com/yarnpkg/yarn/pull/9203 replaces '.*' after '-----BEGIN ' with '(?:(?!-).)*' and adds a regression test. Checked the bundled lib/cli.js in both DHI yarn packages published for Alpine 3.23 (noarch, identical on x86_64 and aarch64): 1.22.22-r1 still contains the vulnerable expression, and 1.22.22_git20260211-r2, built with that change applied, contains the corrected expression and not the vulnerable one. Under apk ordering 1.22.22-r1 sorts below 1.22.22_git20260211-r2.
